english.title: Operator or pilot of aircraft which descended when relevant runway visual range below minimum for landing
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of a public transport aircraft registered elsewhere than in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), which, when making a descent to the aerodrome at **(..SPECIFY AERODROME..), descended from a height of 1,000 feet or more above it to a height of less than 1,000 feet above it when the relevant runway visual range there was at the time less than the specified minimum for landing
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 132(6) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
